## Core Services

### 1. Shopify Speed Optimization & Core Web Vitals Engineering
- **URL:** https://klickspell.com/services/shopify-speed-optimization
- **The Problem:** High-growth Shopify stores accumulate dozens of third-party apps, tracking tags, and unoptimized assets that freeze mobile processors and degrade conversion rates.
- **The Solution:** 
  - Contractual 90+ Mobile Google PageSpeed guarantee.
  - Critical CSS inlining and elimination of render-blocking asset waterfalls.
  - Batch conversion of raster assets to modern WebP with responsive `srcset` and explicit dimensional attributes.
  - Non-blocking script scheduling via `requestIdleCallback` and intent-driven hydration for tracking tags (Meta Pixel, TikTok, Klaviyo, Google Tag Manager).
  - All work executed safely in duplicate preview themes with zero production downtime.

### 2. Custom Shopify Theme Development (Shopify 2.0)
- **URL:** https://klickspell.com/services/custom-shopify-development
- **The Problem:** Generic off-the-shelf themes and visual page builders (PageFly, Shogun, GemPages) introduce heavy JS bundles, break mobile responsiveness, and lock brands into monthly app subscriptions.
- **The Solution:**
  - 100% bespoke Liquid 2.0 themes crafted from custom Figma designs.
  - Granular theme customizer section blocks giving marketing teams complete control over copy, layouts, badges, and media.
  - Custom subscription flows (Recharge, Bold) and custom bundle builders.
  - Clean handover with video documentation and zero page-builder overhead.

### 3. Headless Commerce & Custom Web Applications
- **URL:** https://klickspell.com/services/headless-commerce
- **The Problem:** Standard monolithic platforms cannot bridge complex multi-tier business models (such as selling physical products alongside live appointment consultations in a single cart).
- **The Solution:**
  - Modern composable architectures using Next.js 14 App Router, Medusa.js v2, and Strapi CMS.
  - Real-time calendar booking integrations (Cal.com API) linked directly to cart checkout webhooks.
  - Multi-currency Stripe checkout and automated PDF invoice dispatch.
  - Custom ERP workflows and database migrations using Node.js, MongoDB, and Frappe/ERPNext.

### 4. Interactive Diagnostic Tool: Website Speed & Third-Party Bloat Estimator
- **URL:** https://klickspell.com/speed
- **Features:**
  - Live real-time mobile speed diagnostic powered by Google PageSpeed Insights API simulating throttled 4G mobile devices.
  - Interactive Shopify App Bloat Estimator calculating estimated CPU delay, JavaScript payload weight, and conversion impact across 25+ popular apps (Klaviyo, Judge.me, Recharge, Yotpo, Hotjar, Gorgias, Lucky Orange, Loox, PageFly, etc.).
  - Programmatic WebMCP tool access: `audit_mobile_speed` and `calculate_app_bloat`.
